script_text: Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury, your ruling planet, is retrograde in Leo and squaring Saturn in your 9th House of Belief, dragging your airy element into a clash over truth and travel plans. In love, singles attract a fiery communicator if they ditch small talk, while taken Geminis must watch passive-aggressive texts from a partner. Career-wise, a Venus trine to Jupiter in your 2nd House of Money signals an unexpected raise or client bonus if you invoice by noon. Warning: avoid signing any contract under Mercury's shadow or you'll regret the fine print. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
